olympiad_full_name: Central American and Caribbean Mathematical Olympiad
statement: An ordered triple $(p,q,r)$ of primes is \textit{parcera} if $p\mid q^2-4$, $q\mid r^2-4$, $r\mid p^2-4$. Find all parcera triples.
source: Central American and Caribbean Mathematical Olympiad 2021

olympiad_full_name: Central American and Caribbean Mathematical Olympiad
statement: $\triangle ABC$ with circumcircle $\Gamma$; $D\in AB$ with $CD\parallel$ tangent to $\Gamma$ at $A$. $E=CD\cap\Gamma$, $F=BC\cap\odot(ADC)$ ($F\neq C$). $G$ = intersection of $AB$ with internal bisector of $\angle DCF$. Show $E,G,F,C$ are concyclic.
source: Central American and Caribbean Mathematical Olympiad 2021

olympiad_full_name: Central American and Caribbean Mathematical Olympiad
statement: A $2021\times 2021$ board has some black cells. A mouse at any cell can walk in a straight line (up/down/left/right) and exit the board without walking on any black cell (except possibly its start). Find the maximum number of black cells.
source: Central American and Caribbean Mathematical Olympiad 2021

olympiad_full_name: Central American and Caribbean Mathematical Olympiad
statement: 2021 people at a meeting: one has no friends, another has exactly one friend. For any 4 people, at least 2 are friends. Show 2018 people are all mutual friends.
source: Central American and Caribbean Mathematical Olympiad 2021

olympiad_full_name: Central American and Caribbean Mathematical Olympiad
statement: $n\geq 3$; positive reals $a_1,\ldots,a_n$ with smallest $m$ and largest $M$. For any distinct $i,j,k$ with $a_i\leq a_j\leq a_k$: $a_ia_k\leq a_j^2$. Show $a_1a_2\cdots a_n\geq m^2M^{n-2}$ and find equality conditions.
source: Central American and Caribbean Mathematical Olympiad 2021

olympiad_full_name: Central American and Caribbean Mathematical Olympiad
statement: $\triangle ABC$ with $AB<AC$, $M$ = midpoint of $AC$. $P\in BC$ ($P\neq B$) with $AB=AP$. $D$ = second intersection of circumcircle of $\triangle ABP$ with $AC$; $E$ = second intersection with $PM$. $K=AP\cap DE$. $F\in BC$ ($F\neq P$) with $KP=KF$. Show $C,D,E,F$ are concyclic.
source: Central American and Caribbean Mathematical Olympiad 2021
